prompt.text: You are moving into a shared flat. Write to Luca, your future flatmate: say what you do in the evening and at the weekend, and ask him two questions about his habits.

exercises.correct_answer: Ciao Luca! La sera leggo o guardo un film, e il fine settimana suono la chitarra. Cucino molto! E tu? Guardi la tv la sera? Preferisci la musica o il calcio? A presto!
hints: Luca is your age: use tu for the questions.
